settings.title: Analysis: cartridge path
settings.description: The cartridge path the analysis uses for every storefront, first cartridge first, separated by colons. Empty: each site's path from the site archives of the checkout (sites/<site>/site.xml), else from the git ref below.

settings.title: Analysis: metadata git ref
settings.description: A git ref (a branch or tag) whose site archives and metadata the analysis reads, without checking it out, when the checkout has none. Empty: not read.
